question: What was the hardest thing and the happiest thing for Rom-ji when raising Felt? I’m very interested in what Valga Cromwell was like when taking care of a baby!
answer:
Rom-ji, or Valga Cromwell, was one of the three representatives who led the demi-human side during the Demi-Human War. After a series of twists and turns, he ended up taking Felt in, bringing us to where we are now.

But at the time, Rom-ji didn't like humans at all, so he thought:

“If this brat dies of malnutrition, then that's just how it is.”

His days were filled with Felt knocking over his food, making him change her diapers, and generally giving him a hard time. But I think everyone can easily imagine Rom-ji having his heart unexpectedly moved when little Felt tightly grabbed his enormous pinky finger.

And that is exactly what happened! (laughs)

That was the moment Valga Cromwell became “Rom-ji.”
